versionImpact.rationale: Buildchain v2.9 adds Build Facts as a public contract, exposes managed trust badge bundle generation, and fixes web-surface multi-host directory index routing for S3/CloudFront deployments.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Adds public CLI and Node API build facts, module/product fact contracts, release-passport evidence, and Kungfu legacy buildinfo projection from the same source facts.
Adds a single managed badge bundle entrypoint for KFD-1, KFD-2, KFD-3, and Buildchain Release Passport status with machine-readable badge facts.
Fixes multi-surface preview and production hosts so root and nested directory requests resolve to the surface index.html through explicit S3 alias objects.

recovery.rollback: Use the previous exact release tag or previous floating channel ref.
